_comment: Copy to coupa_bulk_import.config.json and fill in. The real config file must be gitignored — it contains credentials.

coupa._comment_max_requests_per_second: self-imposed aggregate cap, split across supervised children. Coupa allows 25/s per OAuth client; keep headroom (default 20). Drop to ~15 when import webhooks are live on the same client

rossum.token: <bearer token — mint long-lived: POST /auth/login with max_token_lifetime_s 583200 (162h platform max). Re-read from this file on DS 401 and by every supervised relaunch, so a fresh token dropped here heals running jobs. SSO users: use a password-auth integration user to mint it>

purchase_orders._comment_workers: optional (default 1): supervised children crawling disjoint id ranges in parallel. Size from the --probe report; requires --supervise
purchase_orders._comment_extra_params: optional: extra Coupa query params merged into EVERY call for this dataset (fetch, --probe counting, partition planning) — use for filtered slices, e.g. {"created-at[gt_or_eq]": "..."} or {"active": "true"}. Reserved (rejected): fields, order_by, dir, offset, limit, updated-at[lt_or_eq], id[lt], id[gt]
